correctness.rationale: For 2 and 4 and 8 edges, elementary degree and two-row interpolation lemmas give induced exact half. For 16 edges, absence of a star/two-row/degree-subset witness reduces both ordered positive-degree partitions to P or Q; two independent source programs enumerate all 57,786 admissible 0-1 incidence matrices, independently verify attainable count eight, and print matching counts (906,6720,6720,43440). Graphs with arbitrary isolated vertices and other sizes are covered by the mathematical reduction and hypothesis-subclass monotonicity. The upper bound is the \(2^d\) leaf count. All computations were replayed from this package’s actual verifier source files, not logs alone.
